name: 19152-longdecode-8b-1gpu
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=4, bounded at 40 requests / 2700 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion. streams is part of the declaration and is not searched; if it ever has to move, it moves DOWN.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 500 tokens and output exactly 6400 (min = max on both); the backend forces ignore_eos when max_tokens is set, so every request is one prefill against 6399 decode steps and its context grows from 500 to 6900 tokens.
purpose: A long-form report writer generating 6,400-token drafts from short briefs for four concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit c48c6c4008ab3ba0a2ab2d9c04b285a5d6a58b88 (`git describe` = v0.9.1-117-gc48c6c4008ab3).
# Interpreter and hardware seal: configs/env.yaml (NOT portable, per-machine).
# Nothing here is tuned.

# Ungated mirror of the gated meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct: same weights, same vocab.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false

# THE ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE THIS ITEM CANNOT BE RUN WITHOUT. There is no `attention-backend`
# engine argument at this commit -- the only selector is the environment variable, set at launch:
#
#   VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=TRITON_ATTN_VLLM_V1
#
# Left unset, vllm/platforms/cuda.py picks FLASH_ATTN on an H100 and the backend this item is
# declared on is never loaded: the run succeeds and has measured something else. That is the
# silent failure. The spelling is this engine's: `TRITON_ATTN` is not a member of `_Backend` here
# (vllm/platforms/interface.py has TRITON_ATTN_VLLM_V1) and the later short name would raise
# `ValueError: Invalid attention backend`. That failure is loud.
# VLLM_USE_V1 needs no line: it already defaults to 1 at this commit.
